title: The .LLab Legacy Infrastructure Plan™
intro: Plan it. Decision rights, priorities, ownership, and a 12-month plan your leadership team manages.

nodes.prompt: Our legacy priorities in rank order, why each protects the legacy, and the measure of success for each:
For each type of decision: who decides, who is consulted, who is informed, and which value guides it?
For each area of the organization: the owner, the backup, and whether it is documented (yes or no):
What depends on one person, who that person is, how high the risk is (low, medium or high), and the plan to transfer it:
Each priority, the value it serves, the team that carries it, and who it serves:
For each quarter: what we build, who owns it, and what done looks like:

closing.prompt: The one change we will make next, who will own it, and by when:
